route.title: Walkthrough
steps: Talk to Kaqemeex in the stone circle north of Taverley. Dialogue: "I'm in search of a quest.", "Okay, I will try and help."
Talk to Sanfew, who is upstairs in the Herb shop in Taverley. Dialogue: "I've been sent to help purify the Varrock stone circle.", "Ok, I'll do that then."
Bring the four meats to the Cauldron in Taverley Dungeon, and use them on the Cauldron to enchant them.
